name: uNotes
description:
uNotes is a study library of university course materials - past exams, assignments, lab reports and lecture notes, organized by school and course. Every one of the eight tools in this connector is read-only. All eight are annotated readOnlyHint: true, destructiveHint: false, idempotentHint: true and openWorldHint: false, so nothing on this surface creates, edits, uploads or deletes anything in a uNotes account, and nothing reaches the open internet. Ask Claude to generate a quiz, make flashcards, upload a file or change your profile and it has no tool for it and will say so - those stay in the uNotes app.

What Claude can do is read. It can search the library, open a document and read its text, list your flashcard decks and quizzes, look up your study streak, check how much of your monthly quota is left, and list the schools and courses on the platform. Document search covers the shared uNotes library: documents that are completed and public in the app are searchable and readable here, while anything still processing or not public is visible only to its owner and comes back as not found for everyone else. Your personal data - flashcards, quizzes, streak and quota - is always scoped to your own account, and no tool accepts a user identifier as an argument.

Authorization is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE (S256) and unauthenticated dynamic client registration, an explicit consent screen, and seven granular read scopes - search, documents, flashcards, quizzes, study, profile and library - plus offline_access. Tools are registered per request against the scopes your token actually carries, so a scope you decline makes the matching tools invisible rather than merely blocked. Requests are rate-limited per user, and disconnecting the uNotes connector in Claude ends the calls. Nothing is sold in chat, no images, video or audio are generated, and no ads are served.

_published_faq.name: How do I add uNotes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add uNotes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://unotes.net/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the uNotes MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: uNotes provides these MCP tools: get_document, get_document_content, get_quota_status, get_study_streak, list_my_flashcards, list_my_quizzes, list_schools_courses, and search_library.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to uNotes?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to uNotes in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
uNotes requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
uNotes is developed by Devino Solutions. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
